phase4_k2_moving_hole_mathematics.scope: k=2 singleton moving-hole / dynamic-sentinel boundary only
successful_mechanisms: For any finite scan state and fresh sentinel, the avoidance continuations form a computable binary tree; uniform eventual consumption yields a computably searchable finite deadline.
Given a finite deadline, finite conditional expectation exactly hedges the deferred logical wager on a sentinel revealed early, with no multiplicative turnover loss.
Any genuinely unbounded singleton turnover is target-consumed but omittable on a sibling continuation.
Finite-horizon portfolio/savings accounting has vanishing tail coverage and yields no rate-free infinite-turnover lower bound from output-martingale unboundedness alone.
A simple global k=2 fair-coin singleton-spine comb verifies the query-set geometry but not a computably random witness.
phase4_k2_moving_hole_mathematics.unresolved_mechanism: No computable unbounded deferred-wager value, no rate-free dynamic-sentinel transfer, and no exact adaptive singleton-spine destroyer were obtained.

phase4_k2_optional_projection_mathematic.scope: k=2 branchwise-avoidable capped optional-projection / adaptive singleton-spine boundary only
successful_mechanisms: An exact global k=2 no-repeat scan can have a branchwise sentinel-consumption probability equal to a noncomputable left-c.e. real.
A bounded computable output martingale with cap 2 has eventual-consumption/threshold payoff whose first exact optional-projection values are 1-alpha and 1+alpha, hence noncomputable.
Finite-horizon projected values are computable but need not have a computable convergence modulus after threshold capping.
An adaptive least-unqueried-sentinel comb can satisfy totality, fair-coin preservation, global k=2 fibres, singleton-spine exhaustion, freshness and non-pre-revelation simultaneously.
phase4_k2_optional_projection_mathematic.unresolved_mechanism: No computably random source is proved on an infinite all-trigger correct-prediction spine, and no alternative rate-free one-martingale transfer is obtained.

phase4_k2_autoreduction_spine_mathematic.scope: k=2 adaptive c.e.-trigger singleton-spine source-randomness question only
phase4_k2_autoreduction_spine_mathematic.next_question: structural equivalence between partial autoreduction/predictor schemes and singleton-spine global-k2 no-repeat scan destroyers

phase4_k2_predictor_boundary_mathematics.scope: k=2 partial-predictor / singleton-scan converse boundary only
successful_mechanisms: The P4-S011 least-fresh conversion does not use the wtt use bound or predictions at filler coordinates.
Sentinel-local c.e.-visible self-avoiding correct predictions suffice; target-winning rational fractional stakes suffice more generally.
Every computably-random winning global-k=2 no-repeat scan is singleton by P4-S008 and induces a self-avoiding stake functional total on that source.
The induced stakes reproduce the winning rational martingale exactly in the original scan order.
All-in wagers on a succeeding path are necessarily correct.
phase4_k2_predictor_boundary_mathematics.unresolved_mechanism: Arbitrary martingale success does not force an all-correct bit autoreduction, and reordering the induced stakes into a new least-fresh comb is not justified. The next boundary is effective sibling totality.

phase4_k2_sibling_totality_mathematics.scope: k=2 sibling-totality / finite-deadline boundary inside least-fresh scan subclass only
successful_mechanisms: Full oracle-totality implies reachable-sentinel totality but is stronger than needed.
At a reachable epoch, the nontriggering continuations form a computable finitely branching avoidance tree; no infinite path is equivalent to a computably searchable finite trigger deadline.
Reachable-sentinel totality makes every epoch terminate on every source and forces the least-fresh scan to query every coordinate exactly once.
The induced map has singleton fibres and an everywhere computable inverse, so P4-S001 / SRC-0015 / THM-0038 gives computable-randomness invariance.
P4-S009 finite hedges concatenate because every turnover now has a searched finite deadline.
A functional diverging on a coordinate always used as a filler separates reachable-sentinel totality from full oracle-totality.
phase4_k2_sibling_totality_mathematics.unresolved_mechanism: No theorem is proved for almost-everywhere or quantitative tail sibling-totality. Branchwise avoidance is not claimed to imply destruction in every instance.

phase4_k2_budgeted_tail_mathematics.next_question: computable stake-weighted skipped-wager loss budget with nonsummable raw miss probabilities

phase4_k2_weighted_loss_mathematics.scope: k=2 stake-weighted skipped-wager loss budget inside least-fresh stake subclass only
successful_mechanisms: A computable savings wrapper makes output-martingale success diverge along all late prefixes without increasing fractional stake sizes.
Finite miss tickets are priced by computable leafwise majorants of the positive multiplicative gain of a deferred sentinel wager that would be skipped.
Divergent realized miss weights are caught by weighted tickets; finite realized weight leaves the restart hedge at a positive multiplicative scale.
An explicit two-control-bit scan has permanent avoidance probability 1/4 at every epoch, so no P4-S014 raw-tail certificate exists, while small sentinel stakes give weighted budget at most 1/4.
The exact pointwise minimal future-loss envelope is not uniformly computable.
P4-S011's all-in destroyer cannot satisfy any finite certificate of this form.
phase4_k2_weighted_loss_mathematics.unresolved_mechanism: The advance computable future-loss envelope is extra effective data; it is not yet known whether incremental tickets can remove it without computing an infinite optional projection.

phase4_k2_incremental_ticket_mathematics.scope: k=2 envelope-free incremental postmiss loss-ticket transfer inside least-fresh stake subclass only
successful_mechanisms: After a horizon miss, both child losses at the next fresh filler are exactly computable before that filler is drawn.
The exact fair one-step premium is the average of the two child losses and is locally minimal for a one-step covering ticket.
A finite uniform pathwise premium budget funds an insurance martingale whose payouts equal realized positive skipped gains.
Finite realized skipped gain leaves the P4-S015 restart hedge at positive scale; divergent realized gain makes insurance succeed.
No infinite optional projection, future supremum or advance computable envelope is used.
P4-S011 has divergent premium sum on its computably random target for every computable horizon selector.
phase4_k2_incremental_ticket_mathematics.unresolved_mechanism: Whether the absolute premium-sum budget can be replaced by a computable self-financing reserve/admissibility condition.

successful_mechanisms: A computable loss threshold h(K) forcing prior ticket capital K is enough for the P4-S017 transfer.
The condition permits divergent absolute premium sums.
A computable mode switch between the two settled P4-S017 gadgets gives semantic coercivity with no uniform loss-to-capital threshold even noncomputably.
Loss-properness b(K)<infinity is the exact set-theoretic condition restoring a uniform threshold.
P4-S011 admits no effective modulus for any computable horizon selector.
phase4_k2_effective_coercivity_mathemati.unresolved_mechanism: Whether finite b(K) in a computable k=2 ticket tree automatically has a computable uniform upper bound.

phase4_k2_loss_properness_effectivity_ma.scope: k=2 loss-properness effectivity boundary inside least-fresh ticket/restart architecture only
successful_mechanisms: For a computable ticket tree, b(K) is uniformly lower semicomputable.
